Name: AutoHealAndEnergize
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
[list]
[*]This mod helps you manage consumables more efficiently.
[*]It allows quick manual use of recovery items and automates their usage.
[*]When vanilla gameplay restricts item use, like in special locations or under the Nauseated debuff, the mod will also prevent usage. However, ginger-based foods can still be consumed when under the Nauseated debuff, just like in vanilla.
[/list]
[b]How to Use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Press the[b][color=#6d9eeb] G key[/color][/b] (default) to open the food bag and add food.
[*]Adjust automatic and manual use settings in GMCM.
[*]Food from the bag will be automatically consumed when your stamina or health is low!
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b][list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[*]Set the health and stamina thresholds for automatic food use.
[*]Configure a hotkey for quickly eating from the food bag.
[*]Set a priority for food consumption based on recovery amount.
[/list]
